text: vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti . dukkhaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipari- ṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti . no hetaṃ bhante .pe. jivhā niccā vā aniccā vāti . aniccā bhante . rasā niccā vā aniccā vāti . aniccā bhante . jivhāviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . jivhāsamphasso nicco
